title: Morgan Asset Management: US Stocks Will Weather Any Short-Term and Volatile Correction
summary: Jack Caffrey from Morgan Asset Management stated that although some signals suggest US stocks may have become overvalued, strong corporate earnings growth is supporting market sentiment, and US stocks still have room for further gains. Caffrey believes that even though the economic expansion has lasted for years, corporate earnings are expected to grow by 22% or more in 2026. He also mentioned that the earnings growth rate last year was in the mid-range of 10%-20%, and it is expected to remain at this level in 2027. "This is indeed a story driven by earnings," he said. "I remain bullish on the current stock market." (Bloomberg Television)
The U.S. Department of Agriculture reported a new case of screwworm in La Salle County, Texas.

SpaceX plans to go public on June 12, and Starlink is a key revenue driver for the company's $175 billion valuation.

summary: Goldman Sachs notes that AI investment is shifting from 'capability competition' to 'monetization struggle'. The return threshold implied by the $100 billion annual capital expenditure has exceeded historical levels, with open-source models and on-premise inference solutions compressing AI economics, leading to increased incentives for companies to delay spending. Meanwhile, a $100 billion leveraged exposure in global semiconductor and hardware-related stocks, combined with retail participation, creates tail risk.
Meta plans to appeal the European Union's ruling on WhatsApp's AI commands.

title: UK 2-Year Treasury Yield Falls Over 4 Basis Points, Following Global Oil Price Decline
summary: On Tuesday (June 9), during the European session close, the UK 10-year government bond yield fell 3.4 basis points to 4.909%, remaining in decline throughout the day and reaching a daily low of 4.891% at 21:49 Beijing time. The 2-year UK government bond yield dropped 4.4 basis points to 4.335%, touching a daily low of 4.315%. The 30-year UK government bond yield fell 2.9 basis points, while the 50-year yield declined by 2.6 basis points. The 2/10-year UK government bond yield spread rose 0.677 basis points to +57.142 basis points.

title: BP's New CEO Unveils Major Restructuring, Reaffirms Focus on Oil and Gas
summary: BP's new CEO announced a comprehensive restructuring of the company's leadership and reporting structure, refocusing the business on core oil and gas operations, reversing the low-carbon transition strategy initiated by the previous CEO in 2020. title: Large Certificate of Deposit Offers Limited-Time Deals, Diversified Deposit-Gathering Strategies Reshape Pricing Logic
summary: Recently, several regional banks, including Hangzhou Bank, Xi'an Bank, and Xiuwenshang Rural Commercial Bank, have launched large certificates of deposit with limited-time offers. This round of new products mainly features short-term varieties, with annualized interest rates generally higher than those of ordinary time deposits of the same term. Some products have seen interest rates exceed 2%. In terms of issuance rules, most banks have adopted a limited-time and limited-quantity model to restrict availability. Industry insiders analyze that, in the current market environment, banks' temporary introduction of high-interest large certificates of deposit is an important means of differentiated deposit-gathering. The withdrawal or de-listing of medium- and long-term high-interest deposits by multiple banks, as well as the control of large certificate of deposit quotas, reflects an operational choice to optimize liability structure and reduce funding costs.

title: China's Largest Integrated Photovoltaic-Hydrogen-Energy Storage Project Completes Construction
summary: According to state media, the Guohua Investment Jiangsu Rudong Integrated Photovoltaic-Hydrogen-Energy Storage Project has been fully completed. This is the largest offshore photovoltaic demonstration project integrating power generation, hydrogen production, and energy storage in China. The project is located in the coastal mudflat area of Rudong, Jiangsu. It has a total photovoltaic capacity of 400 megawatts, including a new 220-kilovolt onshore substation, a hydrogen production facility with an hourly capacity of 1,500 standard cubic meters, and a electrochemical energy storage power station. As the first project in China that integrates power generation, hydrogen production, and energy storage while also focusing on comprehensive energy utilization and coastal ecological management, it achieves efficient integration of 'power-storage-hydrogen'.

Glass, ceramics, and M8/M9 level PCBs belong to hard, brittle, or ultra-hard systems, where traditional mechanical drilling, wet etching, and conventional laser processing are ineffective. Ultra-fast lasers, with their cold-processing characteristics, have emerged as a solution for precision processing. According to the agreement, both parties will focus on large-scale deployment of AI inference frameworks, deep computing power collaboration, and comprehensive token service cooperation, building a full-stack collaborative system covering 'inference framework + computing power supply + model service + scenario application' to accelerate the construction of the 'Token Factory'. In terms of comprehensive token service cooperation, Silicon Flow will provide large model capabilities covering text, multimodal, and code. Guizhou Mobile will fully integrate token computing power into internal and external real-world application scenarios. Both parties will also jointly establish an integrated operations center for 'monitoring - quality control - billing - service'.

title: Cyberspace Administration of China Emphasizes Strengthening Platform Rule Governance, Enhancing Account Management Efficiency, and Regulating Minors' Internet Usage
summary: The Cyberspace Administration of China held a national network ecological governance work conference in Beijing. The meeting emphasized clarifying goals and tasks, focusing on key areas, and continuously improving the level of network ecological governance capabilities. Efforts should be made to address both symptoms and root causes, improve the quality and effectiveness of special campaigns, and perfect long-term governance mechanisms, ensuring the implementation of institutional measures. Efforts should also be made to strengthen basic management, strictly controlling internet entry points, important traffic entry points, and new business models and applications. In terms of strengthening platform responsibility, it is necessary to enhance platform rule governance, improve account management efficiency, strengthen platform operation management, and standardize and manage minors' internet usage. Efforts should also be made to strengthen technological empowerment, promoting the development of emerging technologies while eliminating their drawbacks, enriching technical means in a timely manner, and proactively planning to drive technology for good purposes.

title: 2026 U.S. College Graduates Express Strong Discontent with AI, Microsoft Responds That Humans Won't Be Replaced

Smith argued that AI deployment is intended to enhance human capabilities, not replace them. He also tried to ease pessimistic predictions about significant upheaval in the job market, pointing out that the time required for AI applications to permeate the entire economy may be longer than what the most enthusiastic advocates claim.

Market expectations for a rate hike next week remain unaffected, with Bloomberg survey showing almost all observers expect the interest rate to rise to 1%, the highest since 1995. summary: The top official responsible for deciding how Swedes invest the majority of their pension savings has expressed opposition to opening private market fund investment channels to pension savers. He stated, 'Private market structures with daily liquidity often tend to bring trouble.'

title: U.S. Military Says It Disabled an Oil Tanker Violating Blockade Measures in the Oman Sea

title: Core Inflation Slightly Below Expectations but Market Still Bets on Rate Hikes This Year
summary: The US core CPI rose 0.2% month-on-month in May, slightly below expectations, offering the Federal Reserve limited room for pause, but bets on rate hikes this year remain unchanged. Interest rate swaps show traders still price in a rate hike before December. Overall CPI rose 4.2% year-on-year, marking the largest increase in three years, driven by rising oil prices due to Middle East tensions. Market speculation on the timing of rate hikes has slightly adjusted: the probability of a September rate hike fell from around 50% to 45%, while October remains at about 60%.
According to market sources, SpaceX's U.S. IPO has attracted more than four times oversubscription.

summary:

title: Apollo Global Management Warns: Professional Services Sectors to Face AI Disruption
summary: Scott Kleinman, co-president of Apollo Global Management, said that professional services sectors, including law firms, accounting firms, and consulting companies, are likely to be the next area disrupted by artificial intelligence. Investors had previously focused their concerns on the software industry and the extent to which AI would disrupt these businesses. However, Kleinman stated during a panel discussion at the SuperReturn conference in Berlin on Wednesday that, looking ahead, acquisition companies should focus on investments in the professional services sector. 'I apologize to the lawyers, accountants, and consultants here, but I do believe that will be a sector facing significant pressure.'

title: Report: Trump has launched over 10,000 military strikes globally since returning to the White House, with no sign of stopping

The 'peace president's' actual actions starkly contrast with campaign promises. Analysts suggest that the use of force has become a core policy tool, and the U.S. may continue facing war conflicts.

title: Netanyahu Claims Israeli Forces Have Killed Nearly 10,000 Hezbollah Fighters
summary: On local time on the 10th, Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu stated in a statement that, as of now, the Israel Defense Forces have killed nearly 10,000 Hezbollah fighters in combat. The Israeli military is currently conducting a 'systematic' campaign to eliminate active Hezbollah forces in southern Lebanon. title: Middle Eastern Sovereign Wealth Funds Rush to Invest in SpaceX IPO: Saudi, Qatar, and Kuwait Funds Commit Billions

title: U.S. CPI Hits Three-Year High, Wall Street Unshaken: 'New Fed Correspondent' Says Report Leaves Everything Unresolved
summary: Wall Street institutions believe that this CPI strengthens the logic of maintaining high interest rates for a longer period, but it is not enough to trigger a rate hike. The Federal Reserve is likely to keep rates unchanged in the coming months. Timiraos noted that the Federal Reserve officials cannot draw any definitive conclusions from the May CPI report. Surging energy costs drove overall CPI higher, weakening the significance of the more moderate core CPI. The rationale for patience no longer depends on a single report but requires a series of data showing cooling inflation. The Fed's recent shift toward a hawkish stance remains unchanged.

title: US Attack Disrupts Water Supply for Over 20,000 People in Iran
summary: According to Iranian authorities, the US launched an attack on southern Iran early on Sunday, damaging water supply facilities in the Sirik area of Hormozgan Province, leaving more than 20,000 residents without access to drinking water at one point. Local officials said that two water storage facilities were destroyed in the attack, causing the water supply system to malfunction. The city of Kuhak and 10 surrounding villages experienced a complete water outage. Due to the high temperatures in the region, the water shortage significantly affected residents' daily lives, and the local government provided water via tankers to the affected population.

title: Fed rate hike expectations surge, ING says gold, Bitcoin and Swiss franc face inflation pricing liquidation
summary: ING believes that the market's current expectation of the Federal Reserve implementing a stringent interest rate hike to curb inflation has fully resurfaced. This sharp shift has directly crushed the 'debasement trade' that was prevalent after President Trump's inauguration. The strong rise in real interest rates has inflicted a fatal squeeze on the previous currency depreciation trade that had been widely adopted last year. The core logic of this trading model was that the market believed the Fed had become entirely subordinate to Washington, only blindly catering to political inflation demands. With the sharp increase in real interest rates, inflation hedging assets that had previously attracted safe-haven capital - gold, Bitcoin and the Swiss franc - have recently faced collective short-seller pressure and valuation liquidation.

title: India Considers Historic Introduction of Canadian Heavy Crude to Hedge Against Middle East Supply Disruptions
summary: India's senior envoy to Canada, Dinesh Patnaik, disclosed at the Global Energy Show in Calgary, Alberta, a major energy hub, that India is considering Canada as a potential new oil supplier due to current geopolitical tensions. India's newly commissioned modern refineries are fully designed to process heavy crude oil, making Canadian heavy and high-sulfur crudes such as WCS highly commercially and technically viable.

title: More than 100 Product Categories Lead Globally, China's Consumer Goods Industry Continues to Improve
summary: According to the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, in the first four months of this year, the added value of large-scale consumer goods industries grew by 4.3% year-on-year, accounting for 27% of the total added value of large-scale industries; revenue reached about 10.3 trillion yuan, up 2.7% year-on-year; the number of employees, total profit, and export delivery value accounted for about 30% of the total for large-scale industries. Currently, the total variety of consumer goods in China has reached 230 million, with more than 100 categories such as home appliances, furniture, cultural and sports supplies, and clothing and textile products ranking among the world's top in production. Innovative products such as smart home appliances, wearable devices, humanoid robots, and drones are steadily increasing in supply. (CCTV)

title: Key Takeaways from the US May CPI Inflation Report
summary:
1. Core Data Matrix: Sharp Divergence Between Overall and Core CPI. The headline CPI in the US showed a stark 'headline CPI surge, core CPI cooling' pattern in May. The CPI rose 4.2% year-on-year, marking the largest increase since April 2023; the core CPI increased by a marginal 0.2% month-on-month, significantly slowing from the 0.4% rise in April.

2. Underlying Drivers and Sub-Sectors: The core underlying logic is entirely dominated by the 'second wave of inflation' triggered by the Middle East geopolitical military conflict. Energy commodities and transportation costs (the main drivers of the surge). Energy product prices surged 3.9% month-on-month, with a total 12-month year-on-year increase in US energy prices reaching an alarming 23.5%. Gasoline prices rose 40.5% year-on-year. Over 60% of the month-on-month headline CPI increase was fully attributed to the sharp rise in energy prices.

The soaring jet fuel prices due to strait blockades dragged airfare prices up 26.7% year-on-year. 

2. Auto insurance and goods-side core CPI cooled more than expected, mainly due to a sharp 1.7% drop in car insurance prices (the largest monthly decline since October 2020).

title: Gates: Suffered from Epstein's Suffocating Extortion
summary:
Microsoft co-founder Bill Gates admitted during a hearing before a U.S. House of Representatives subcommittee that his multiple meetings with the late notorious financier Jeffrey Epstein were 'a significant judgment error.' Gates emphasized that if his close relationship at the time objectively provided Epstein with political or social credibility, he felt 'deeply ashamed and apologized.'

During the hearing, Gates revealed that after cutting all ties with the financier, Epstein maliciously used 'sensitive personal information obtained about me,' including details about Gates' extramarital affair, to extort him in a suffocating manner, attempting to force him to rejoin his inner circle.

title: U.S. Refunds Nearly $22 Billion in Tariffs in May, Nearly Offset Monthly Tariff Revenue
summary: The U.S. Treasury refunded nearly $22 billion in tariff revenue to importers in May. This marks the first such refunds since the Supreme Court overturned most of Trump's tariff measures. According to a statement released by the Treasury on Wednesday, the total amount of tariffs refunded in May increased significantly from $2 billion in April. Looking at the first eight months of this fiscal year, the overall budget deficit narrowed to $1.25 trillion, a 9% decrease from the same period last year. Meanwhile, tariff revenue reached a peak in October of last year. The Treasury statement showed that the amount of tariff refunds in May was roughly equivalent to the amount collected in the same month, meaning the two largely offset each other.

title: Anthropic CEO: Governments Should Have Authority to Block or Restrict Deployment of High-Risk New AI Models
summary: Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic, stated that AI models should undergo mandatory third-party testing covering multiple risk dimensions including cybersecurity threats and bioweapons. If a model is deemed to pose 'unacceptable risks,' 'governments should have the authority to block or restrict its deployment.' This contrasts with President Trump's recent executive order, which only requires AI developers to provide voluntary access to the U.S. government without requiring pre-deployment approval.

title: Google Launches DiffusionGemma: Fourfold Speed Increase in Text Generation, Focused on Local Real-Time Applications
summary: Google released the open-source experimental model DiffusionGemma, which disrupts traditional word-by-word generation logic by generating 256 tokens in parallel during each forward pass. Testing on H100 showed a speed of over 1,000 tokens per second, achieving up to fourfold acceleration. The model activates only 3.8B parameters and can run on consumer-grade GPUs with 18GB of memory after quantization, offering developers a new technical path for low-latency local workflows.

title: Trump Claims U.S. Secretly Helped Over 200 Merchant Ships Pass Through Hormuz Strait
summary: On May 10, former U.S. President Trump stated that the U.S. military had secretly assisted more than 200 merchant ships to pass through the Hormuz Strait. On the same day, he posted on social media that he had ordered the military to carry out a secret operation in April to support oil tankers and other merchant vessels passing through the strait. The operation has resulted in 'over 100 million barrels of oil successfully passing through the strait and entering the open market, with more than 200 merchant ships safely passing through.' He also claimed that 'the control of the Hormuz Strait is in the hands of the United States, not Iran.'

title: 10-Year U.S. Treasury Yield Rises 2.4 Basis Points on Day of CPI Inflation Data, 2-Year Real Yield Jumps 4.8 Basis Points

It hit a daily low of 4.5105% at 20:30 Beijing time when the U.S. CPI inflation data was released, and then reached a daily high of 4.5562% at 01:39 following the U.S. Treasury's announcement of the 10-year bond auction results. title: 2022 Interest Rate Scenarios Won't Repeat, but Flexibility Is Critical
summary: Wellington Management released its 2026 interest rate outlook, noting that high starting yields continue to make global government bonds attractive. However, the U.S.-Iran conflict could lead to a structural rise in oil prices, persistent inflation above targets, and higher risk premiums. Markets are at a crossroads of growth and inflation, and investors need to maintain flexibility to capture opportunities arising from divergent policies across countries.

title: Assessing Climate Physical Risks for Sovereign Nations: Focus on Asia
summary: Amundi report highlights that Asia is a region highly exposed to climate physical risks, with potential GDP losses reaching 10%-16% by 2050. South and Southeast Asia face the highest risks, while vulnerable countries such as Maldives and Sri Lanka may experience fiscal pressures that could impact sovereign credit ratings and bond yields. The gap in adaptation financing is significant, with COP29 setting a new target of $1.3 trillion annually.

title: DOL Proposes Rule to Define Fiduciary Duty in Selecting Designated Investment Alternatives
summary: The U.S. Department of Labor (DOL) released a rule proposal providing a safe harbor for fiduciaries of 401(k) plans in selecting investment options, applicable to portfolio funds containing alternative assets. BlackRock expressed support and recommended refining a six-factor framework (performance, fees, liquidity, valuation, performance benchmark, and complexity) to maintain flexibility and avoid unintended prescriptive requirements.

title: Chewy, Inc.-CHWY-2026-Q1
summary: Chewy's (Q1 2026) net sales reached $3.36 billion, up 7.7%, with adjusted EBITDA margin of 7.5%, an increase of 130 basis points. Active customers reached 21.5 million, up 3.6%, with Autoship sales accounting for 84.4%. Due to macroeconomic pressures, the shift toward premium products has slowed, and the company lowered its full-year revenue guidance to $13.4-$13.55 billion. It maintained its full-year EBITDA margin guidance at 6.6%-6.8%. The company completed the acquisitions of SmartPak and Modern Animal, and generated $71 million in free cash flow, up 45%, demonstrating its profitability resilience.

title: Core & Main, Inc. - CNM - 2026 Q1
summary: Core & Main FY26 Q1 revenue remained flat at $1.9 billion, with adjusted EBITDA rising 1% to $226 million, and EPS up 6% year-over-year to $0.72. Gross margin expanded 50 bps to 27.2%, driven by private brand growth and pricing discipline. Strong municipal demand fueled double-digit growth in smart utility and wastewater treatment solutions, offsetting weakness in the residential market. The data center business maintained momentum, with fire protection sales jumping 17%. The company reaffirmed its full-year guidance and accelerated capital returns, repurchasing $88 million in stock this quarter.

title: Relaxed Regulation in Financial Boom: What Could Go Wrong?
summary: Federal Reserve Governor Barr warned that the current trend of easing bank capital and regulatory requirements could increase financial instability risks. The capital requirements for Global Systemically Important Banks (GSIBs) have been reduced by 6%, equivalent to a $6 billion reduction in buffer. Historical data shows that GDP losses after crises can reach 20%-60%, indicating that short-term 'sugar highs' are far from the long-term costs.

title: Cash and Digital Euro: Complementary Forms of Public Money
summary: Christine Lagarde, executive board member of the German central bank, stated that cash remains the physical core of the monetary system, while the digital euro will serve as a public digital payment supplement, not a replacement for cash. The share of cash transactions in Germany has declined from 74% in 2017 to 51% in 2023. The digital euro design emphasizes efficiency, resilience, and strategic autonomy, with offline functionality to address internet outages. A pilot is planned for the second half of 2027, with potential launch in 2029.

title: The Social Dimensions of Responsible AI Deployment
summary: A report by Amundi highlights the social dimensions of responsible AI deployment, indicating that the AI governance gap continues to widen: only 2.3% of companies have an AI complaint mechanism, and nearly 90% have not committed to a governance framework. Social risks include algorithm management, a 16% decline in employment for young workers, and threats to children's safety. Investors need to push companies to establish a comprehensive AI governance lifecycle.

title: New Round of Savings Bonds Launches, Personal Pension Accounts Channel in High Demand
summary: On June 10, the third and fourth installments of the 2026 savings bonds (electronic type) began to be issued, with a total amount of 70 billion yuan. Unlike previous issues, these bonds have been included in the personal pension product range, with a dedicated quota accounting for 40% of the initial flexible distribution quota for this issuance. Multiple commercial banks, including Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, Communications Bank, Construction Bank, China Merchants Bank, and Everbright Bank, have simultaneously launched the 'savings bonds' purchase function. Investors can log in to the app of the bank where their personal pension account is located, enter the personal pension special zone, deposit funds, and open a bond custody account to make purchases.

title: SpaceX Receives Investment-Grade Ratings from Three Major Bond Rating Agencies
summary: According to market sources, Elon Musk's SpaceX has informed investors that the company has received investment-grade ratings from three major bond rating agencies, which could help reduce financing costs for SpaceX after its IPO. SpaceX is expected to raise approximately $7.5 billion through its initial public offering (IPO). The company is set to price the offering on Thursday and begin trading the following day. Bond market participants have started to focus on SpaceX's next steps, particularly the potential for raising funds through the investment-grade bond market.

The report also anticipates another rate increase in January 2027, with the terminal rate reached by July 2027. The JGB purchase program is expected to remain unchanged until March 2027, after which it will be reduced to approximately 2 trillion yen per month.

summary: Barclays expects the Bank of Japan to raise interest rates to 1% in June, the highest level since 1995. summary: Nomura expects the BoJ to raise rates by 25 basis points to 1.00% in June, a move already fully priced in by the market. Although the purchase volume will remain fixed, the central bank's balance sheet is still expected to continue shrinking due to high redemption levels. title: Japanese Central Bank Governor Haruhiko Kuroda Signals Potential Rate Hike in June
summary: Nomura Analysis: Japanese Central Bank Governor Haruhiko Kuroda's remarks unexpectedly took a hawkish tone, suggesting a possible rate hike at the June 15-16 monetary policy meeting. Despite prior inclination to delay, the executive board may shift its stance to avoid rejection of the proposal, following support from non-executive directors. If implemented, it would mark the first rate hike led by non-executive directors since 1998.

title: Investment Grade Credit Dashboard: Testing the Bull Case

summary: Nomura Securities analysis suggests that the Bank of Japan meeting in June may involve a hawkish rate hike and the termination of quantitative tightening . title: In-Depth Analysis of China's Oil Trade, Refining, and Demand

This measure was primarily to address supply shocks caused by the closure of the Strait of Hormuz, as well as the context of previously excessive imports and large inventory buildups. In February 2026, China's crude oil balance had a surplus of about 2.7 million barrels per day, so the import reduction occurred against a backdrop of supply overhang and did not directly equate to a collapse in oil demand.

title: China and Hong Kong Aviation Sectors: Weakening Demand and Rising Fuel Costs
summary: Hong Kong-based analysts noted that due to a 41% quarter-over-quarter increase in fuel prices and weakening domestic demand, the three major Chinese airlines (Cathay Pacific, China Eastern Airlines, and China Southern Airlines) are expected to report a loss of 17 billion yuan in 2Q26, with an annual loss of 22 billion yuan. The research firm maintains its 'underweight' rating. In contrast, Cathay Airways benefits from strong freight demand and route diversification, maintaining its 'buy' rating with a target price of 15.30 HKD, as it believes the market has overreacted to the recent convertible bond issuance by Swire Group.

title: US CPI Data Review: Identifying Potential Inflation
summary: Financial media reports indicate that the US Headline CPI rose by 0.5% month-on-month in May, with a year-on-year increase to 4.2%, remaining high for the third consecutive month, primarily driven by a surge in energy prices due to the Middle East conflict. It is expected that a decline in oil prices in June will ease Headline pressure, although the Core PCE is likely to remain at a high level of 3.3%.

summary: HSBC reiterates its buy rating on Harbin Electric (1133 HK), with a target price of HKD 32, representing a 83.5% upside from the current price of HKD 17.44. title: US CPI Data Review: Tariff Pass-Through Near Completion, Core Goods Inflation Turns Negative
summary:
Main Views

  1. The effect of tariffs on prices is nearly complete, with core goods inflation turning negative for the first time this year
    Morgan Stanley notes that May's core goods inflation was negative, indicating that the upward price pressure from previous tariffs is fading. Model estimates show that tariffs have only raised price levels by about 60 basis points, close to the expected 70 basis points, and their contribution to PCE has remained stable since February/March, supporting the view of normalized shocks.

  2. Oil price spillovers are limited, mainly concentrated in airfare prices, and the Fed will remain watchful
    Although high oil prices continued to push up gasoline prices for the third consecutive month, leading to higher overall inflation than core inflation, the spillover to core categories remains narrow, mainly reflected in rising airfare prices. Unless the Strait of Hormuz remains closed for an extended period, broader impacts are unlikely. Given the signs of deflation in core goods but uncertain overall effects, the Fed may continue its 'wait and see' approach.

title: Reassessing U.S. Treasury Liquidity Under Iran Tensions: Pressure Mild and Eased
summary:

  1. The overall pressure on the U.S. Treasury market during the Iran conflict was mild, and had largely subsided by May
    Although the bid-ask spreads for U.S. Treasuries widened initially in March during the early stages of the Iran conflict, particularly for short-term maturities (such as the 2-year note), the liquidity stress was lighter compared to other historical stress events. By May, bid-ask spreads and trading volumes on electronic platforms had returned to average levels, indicating stable market function.

  2. The spread widening in March mainly reflected volatility rather than actual liquidity exhaustion
    Analysis of transaction cost metrics adjusted for volatility shows that the spread widening in March coincided with high trading volumes, which is consistent with market uncertainty leading to higher risk premiums by market makers, rather than a liquidity crisis caused by insufficient market depth. In contrast, the regional bank crisis in March 2023 and the 'Liberation Day' event in April 2025 had more significant liquidity impacts.

The Bank of Japan's pace of rate hikes remains relatively lagging, keeping the yen under pressure. UBS recommends going long on the dollar and shorting the euro and yen.

Among them, small-cap and traditional industry companies with poor performance have become the main subjects of control changes, with most companies having a market cap below 5 billion yuan. In terms of transaction plans, the method of entrusting voting rights has gradually been replaced by the combination of voting right waivers and diversified tools. The profile of buyers has also changed, with local state-owned capital remaining a stable acquiring party, while participation from industrial capital has significantly increased.

title: Supply Tightness Drives Egg Prices Higher, Egg Laying Enterprises Expected to See Profit Recovery in Second Quarter
summary: According to historical patterns, May to June is typically a low season for egg consumption, with egg prices usually stable or slightly declining. However, this year has seen a different trend. According to the latest data released by the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, the national average egg price was 10.87 yuan per kilogram in the first week of June, up 5.9% from the previous week and 21.3% year-on-year. In the 10 main producing provinces, including Hebei and Liaoning, the egg price was 10.60 yuan per kilogram, up 41.7% year-on-year. According to industry sources, the overall oversupply situation in the egg market in 2025 has gradually reversed since the second quarter of 2026 due to capacity reduction. Current supply tightness is supporting continued price increases, with the market currently in a state of tight supply and demand balance, and egg laying enterprises are expected to see profit recovery in the second quarter.

summary: UBS research reports that the US Headline CPI rose 4.25% year-on-year in May, which is expected to be the peak for the year. Core CPI increased 2.85% year-on-year with a 0.21% monthly rise. Core goods prices fell for the first time since May last year, indicating weakening tariff effects and a slow downward trend in inflation.

summary: The China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC) has clearly stated its determination to crack down on illegal and regulatory violations such as market manipulation and disorderly market practices. summary: At the Hong Kong Exchange's Future Technology Summit 2026, Liu Ying, Managing Director and Joint Head of IPO Review at Hong Kong Exchanges, revealed that 90 biotechnology companies have successfully listed on the exchange since the introduction of Chapter 18A in 2018, raising a total of HKD 142.9 billion. Among them, 17 companies listed under Chapter 18A in 2025, and six more joined in the first five months of 2026.

title: Subsidies → Token Billing → Price War! OpenAI Sparks Pricing Battle, Is a Turning Point in Token Economics Looming?
summary: When the token price war truly begins, how will the AI industry make money? The entire logic of AI commercialization is reaching a moment that needs to be rewritten. The era of 'cost-effectiveness' and 'scarcity' may be approaching. For OpenAI, 'the situation is deteriorating further,' experts point out that 'if OpenAI declines, it could drag down companies like NVIDIA, Oracle, and Coreweave.'

title: Wang Yi to Visit Mongolia
summary: The Foreign Ministry spokesperson announced that, invited by Mongolian Foreign Minister Batzaya, Wang Yi, a member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Minister of Foreign Affairs, will visit Mongolia from June 13 to 15.

title: China Completes First 'Ship-Grid Interaction' Trial in Lianyungang, Jiangsu
summary: In Lianyungang port, Jiangsu, the pure electric tugboat 'Yun Gang Dian Tuo No.9' successfully achieved bidirectional power supply to the grid, marking China's first implementation of two-way interaction between new energy electric vessels and the grid, and signifying a key step in expanding the energy internet from land-based 'vehicle-grid interaction' to marine applications.

Interbank funding conditions continued to tighten, with the weighted average rate of DR001 rising over 1bp to above 1.4%, marking a new high in the period. The weighted average rate of DR007 increased nearly 3bps to above 1.44%.

title: Eclix's Yu Lei: AI phone without an app to be launched
summary: A research source indicates that the Eclix team has reached a deep collaboration with a leading domestic large model company, and the first generation of AI phone is expected to be released in September 2026, with a launch before the Double Eleven shopping festival. The product is positioned as high-end, with a price above 5,000 yuan. The core team's R&D is nearly complete, and the product is about to enter the system testing phase. The Eclix phone team was established by Yu Lei, former vice president of Gionee Group. Yu Lei officially joined MOVA in March 2026 as the head of the mobile phone and AI hardware business.

title: PeakFly V2000CG Receives eVTOL Type Approval Abroad
summary: According to PeakFly Aviation's WeChat official account on the 11th, PeakFly Aviation Technology's V2000CG Kai Rui'ou has been officially granted a Type Validation Certificate (VTC) by the Indonesian Airworthiness Authority (DGCA), making it the world's first eVTOL model to receive overseas type approval. PeakFly Aviation stated that the granting of the Indonesian VTC demonstrates that the design of the V2000CG meets both the airworthiness standards of its country of origin (China) and the airworthiness requirements of the importing country (Indonesia).
U.S. stock index futures continued to rise, with the Nasdaq Composite index futures up more than 1%, the S&P 500 index futures up 0.67%, and the Dow Jones index futures up 0.62%.

title: Lee Ka-chiu: Hong Kong Expands Cooperation with Kazakhstan
summary: Hong Kong Chief Executive Lee Ka-chiu attended a roundtable meeting hosted by the city of Almaty, Kazakhstan, in Hong Kong today (June 11). Lee noted that Kazakhstan is advancing various reforms and promoting economic diversification, with a focus on building a future-oriented smart city - Almaty. Hong Kong can support Almaty in three areas: first, as a global capital gateway, providing local businesses with diverse financing services such as bond issuance and listing; second, as a gateway to mainland China, helping local companies connect with mainland supply chains and expand into Asian and global markets; third, as a talent and technology partner, leveraging its top-tier higher education resources and globally leading innovation clusters to assist local industrial upgrading.

Government bond futures closed lower, with the main contract of the 30-year issue declining 0.22%, the main contract of the 10-year issue falling 0.10%, the main contract of the 5-year issue down 0.09%, and the main contract of the 2-year issue dropping 0.03%.

title: China Cancels High-Level Talks with EU? Foreign Ministry: Sino-EU Dialogue Remains Ongoing
summary: On June 11, Lin Jian, spokesperson for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, held a regular press conference. According to the Financial Times, due to escalating trade tensions, China has canceled high-level talks with the EU this month. What is the spokesperson's comment on this? Additionally, is Minister of Commerce Wang Wentao still planned to visit the EU later this month as reported? Lin Jian stated that regarding the first issue you mentioned, according to our current understanding, both sides of China and the EU maintain communication on related dialogues. As for the second issue you mentioned, it is recommended to consult the relevant Chinese authorities.

title: Deputy Director of National Energy Administration Meets with President of Saudi Aramco
summary: Song Hongkun, deputy director of the National Energy Administration, met with Mohammad Al-Khathami, president of Saudi Aramco, in Beijing. Both sides exchanged views on international energy security and Sino-Saudi oil and gas cooperation.

title: U.S. Plans to Lend 40 Million Barrels from Strategic Petroleum Reserve to Lower Fuel Prices
summary: The U.S. Department of Energy announced a plan to lend up to 40 million barrels of strategic petroleum reserves to stabilize domestic oil prices amid Middle East conflicts. Current SPR inventory has fallen to a three-year low of 349.2 million barrels. Officials expect to recover 35 to 40 million barrels of crude oil through a maximum 24% physical premium mechanism over the next two years to replenish reserves.

title: Bullish Sentiment for Gold Dips! Traders Bet on Another 40% Drop in the Next Two Years
summary: GLD ETF has fallen 25% from its historical high, and the options market shows extreme bearish bets: some traders have bought deep out-of-the-money put options expiring in 2028, anticipating a further 40% decline in gold within two years. The combination of Turkish central bank selling gold, Gulf countries cashing in military funds, and India's increased import tariffs has created a triple negative impact, with technical support levels being breached triggering algorithmic stop-loss orders.

title: Ministry of Commerce Outlines Latest Progress in Sino-New Zealand Bilateral Economic and Trade Relations
summary: The Ministry of Commerce held a regular press conference. A media representative asked that the 34th China-New Zealand Economic and Trade Commission recently convened in Beijing. Please introduce the specific situation and how to further deepen bilateral economic and trade relations, according to the Ministry of Commerce. In response, He Yadong, spokesperson for the Ministry of Commerce, stated that the 34th China-New Zealand Economic and Trade Commission was held in Beijing on June 5. The Chinese and New Zealand sides exchanged in-depth views on deepening bilateral economic and trade relations and strengthening cooperation in regional and multilateral fields. Both sides agreed to jointly advance the service trade negative list negotiations under the China-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement, enhance communication and cooperation within regional and multilateral frameworks such as the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation and the World Trade Organization, and continue to support a rules-based multilateral trading system.

title: Asia's Currency Defense Shifts to Offshore Markets as Central Banks Intensify Measures Against Foreign Exchange Speculation
summary: From South Korea to India and the Philippines, many Asian central banks have intensified efforts to curb offshore foreign exchange speculation as high oil prices, capital outflows, and a strong US dollar put pressure on regional currencies. The South Korean Ministry of Finance said on Sunday it would increase oversight of offshore currency derivatives, while the Philippines has asked banks to ensure non-deliverable forward contracts are limited to economic purposes. India has tightened limits on unsecured net positions for banks to $1 billion. Indonesia unexpectedly raised interest rates on Tuesday and stated that the central bank is "always active" in global foreign exchange markets to support the rupiah's stability. These warnings highlight concerns among Asian policymakers about offshore transactions exacerbating currency depreciation.

title: SoftBank's OpenAI Collateral Loan Efforts Hit Roadblock, Market Questions Its Creditworthiness
summary: Negotiations for a $6 billion margin loan secured by SoftBank's OpenAI stake have stalled, sending the company's stock down nearly 10% in one day. Lenders remain cautious about valuing unlisted assets, while SoftBank faces a $40 billion bridge debt due in 2027. The contrast between Vision Fund founder Masayoshi Son's bold AI bets and mounting debt pressures has created growing tension.

title: A Million Tokens Cost Just a Few Dollars, Computing Power Prices Continue to Drop
summary: According to a computing power supermarket, they currently offer two types of products: one for computing power and another for large model tokens, with different billing models. The representative said, 'For the computing power rental product, the billing is based on an hour per card. The second option is annual or monthly subscription, which is billed by tokens. Depending on the model, it is usually measured in millions of tokens, and a million tokens cost just a few dollars. According to the current trend, prices are still declining.'

title: Foreign Ministry: Japan Has Removed Its So-Called 'Peace Nation' Mask
summary: At a regular press conference, Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Lin Jian responded to a question regarding reports that multiple sources indicated the Japanese government stated its commitment to the 'exclusive defense' policy as a path of peaceful development has not changed, in response to the joint statement issued by China and Pakistan in mid-May that mentioned opposition to the resurgence of militarism. Lin stated that opposing militarism is an unshakable common will of the international community. While Japan claims to advocate 'peace' and 'defense,' its actions have been rapidly advancing toward 'militarization,' continuously and significantly increasing military spending, relaxing restrictions on the export of lethal weapons, promoting the deployment of medium- and long-range missiles, expanding offensive military capabilities, stockpiling large quantities of sensitive nuclear materials, and pushing for amendments to the 'Peace Constitution.' In fact, Japan has already removed its so-called 'peace nation' mask. The international community should be highly vigilant and must not allow Japanese militarism to resurge.

title: Foreign Ministry Responds to Current Situation in Iran: Military Means Cannot Solve Fundamental Issues
summary: At a regular press conference, Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Lin Jian responded to questions regarding the current situation in Iran. Lin stated that China is seriously concerned about the situation. Military means cannot resolve fundamental issues, and the sovereignty, security, and territorial integrity of regional countries should also be respected and safeguarded. China strongly urges the relevant parties to immediately stop military actions, return to dialogue and negotiations, and achieve a comprehensive and lasting ceasefire as soon as possible.

title: Sun Hongbin of Sunac China: Observes Signs of Recovery in First-tier City Real Estate Markets
summary: Regarding the current trend of the real estate market, Sun Hongbin, chairman of Sunac China, maintains a cautious optimistic view. He stated that the core issue behind the current downturn lies in the lack of consumer confidence in the market, but clear signs of recovery are already visible in first-tier city real estate markets. Meanwhile, Sun Hongbin anticipates a structural transformation in the real estate industry's business model, with traditional development models gradually evolving. In the future, developed properties will shift towards fund-based operations, and high-quality held properties will be revitalized through infrastructure REITs. Sunac will continue to monitor REITs market policies and industry trends, and focus on long-term transformation strategies.

title: Anthropic CEO: I Have Only One Direct Subordinate, the Rest Is Handled by My Sister
summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei revealed a rare management structure - he currently has only one direct subordinate. This arrangement allows him to focus most of his energy on company strategy, research direction, and culture, rather than daily operations. According to reports, the rest of the executive team reports to his sister, Daniela Amodei, who serves as the company's president. This structure enables Amodei to concentrate on strategic planning, cultural development, research direction, and writing about the future of civilization. Anthropic, which was founded just over five years ago, has a private market valuation approaching $1 trillion. Compared with other tech giants, Amodei's management structure is particularly unique - Sam Altman of OpenAI has about six direct subordinates, while Jensen Huang of NVIDIA has dozens.

The China Development Bank issued a 1-year bond with a scale of 4 billion yuan, with an issue rate of 1.2972%, exceeding the expected 1.2900%. The bid coverage was 10.17 times, and the marginal coverage was 8.89 times. The bank also issued a 5-year bond with a scale of 6 billion yuan, with an issue rate of 1.5289%, higher than the expected 1.5200%. The bid coverage was 4.63 times, and the marginal coverage was 7.94 times.

title: Wang Yi to Visit Mongolia, Ministry of Foreign Affairs Provides Details
summary: Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Lin Jian held a regular press conference. A reporter from China Central Television asked, the Chinese side just announced that Foreign Minister Wang Yi will visit Mongolia, could you provide further details about this visit?

title: U.S. Government Invests $2 Billion in Quantum Computing, Why Is Google Missing Out?
summary: The U.S. government has allocated $2 billion in grants to nine companies, including IBM, but Google chose to step back. Charina Chou, Google's head of quantum AI operations, disclosed that the core reason for declining the funding was the conditions attached would slow down its research and development. Google also warned that tightened visa policies are threatening the recruitment of top global talent, potentially undermining the U.S. quantum competitiveness.
Hong Kong chip stocks rebounded in the afternoon, with Lianchu Technology rising more than 5% and Zhaoyi Innovation surging over 4%.

title: White House Plans to Urge Defense Giants to Accelerate Production
summary: According to sources, as the US military continues to deplete its weapon stockpiles in operations such as those in Iran, the US government plans to convene senior executives from major defense companies again to discuss accelerating the production of military equipment. The sources said the White House plans to hold a meeting to promote arms production as early as next week. Due to ongoing conflicts in Iran and the continuous consumption of US military stockpiles from providing weapons and ammunition to Ukraine in recent years, President Trump had an emergency meeting with the leaders of seven major US defense companies in early March this year to discuss production progress and expansion plans.

title: Foreign Ministry: China Supports Thai Authorities' Legal Trial and Severe Punishment of Perpetrators
summary: The spokesperson for the Foreign Ministry, Lin Jian, held a regular press conference. A reporter asked about the Thai court's sentencing of death to the perpetrators of the 2015 Bangkok terrorist attack. What is China's comment on this? Spokesperson Lin Jian stated that we have noted the relevant verdict issued by Thai authorities. The bombing in that incident caused the death of 20 people, including seven Chinese citizens, and injured more than 100 others. The attackers showed no humanity and committed heinous crimes. China supports the legal trial by Thai authorities and severe punishment of the perpetrators. (CCTV)

title: Indian Officials Confirm 3 Crew Members Killed in Attack Near Oman Strait
summary: On local time June 11, India's Minister of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, Sarbananda Sonowal, confirmed that three Indian crew members who went missing aboard a merchant ship attacked near the Oman Strait have been confirmed dead, with the bodies of two of them recovered.

title: Korea's Largest E-commerce Platform Fined for Data Leak
summary: South Korea's largest e-commerce platform, Coupang, has been fined 62.46 billion KRW (approximately 409 million USD) for a data leak and unauthorized collection of personal information, marking the highest penalty of its kind in the country. The incident affected nearly two-thirds of the population, highlighting serious lapses in cybersecurity. Coupang is currently facing a dual challenge of declining user trust and falling sales, with an operating loss of 242 million USD recorded in the first quarter of this year.
Iran's Foreign Ministry stated that the US attack has rendered the ceasefire 'meaningless,' and Iran is determined to eliminate the source of the attack.

title: Aliyun Meoo CLI Launches, Enabling Local AI Coding Projects to Go Live Directly
summary: Aliyun's Meoo (Miao Wu) has launched an open-source command-line tool called Meoo CLI. After installation, local AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor can access cloud capabilities through this tool to complete database integration, user login, file storage, and project deployment, pushing local projects into a production-ready state.

title: Ministry of Commerce: Will Continue to Implement Policies and Accelerate Cultivating New Momentum in Service Trade
summary: The Ministry of Commerce held a regular press conference. He Yadong, spokesperson for the Ministry of Commerce, stated that since the beginning of this year, the Ministry has thoroughly implemented the decisions and arrangements of the Party Central Committee and the State Council, and worked with relevant departments to introduce a series of policies, including promoting exports of travel services, standardizing service trade, accelerating the construction of national service trade innovation development demonstration zones and national digital trade demonstration zones. At the same time, we continue to implement the 'Thousand Sails Sailing Abroad' action plan for foreign cultural trade, helping cultural enterprises expand international markets. In the next step, we will continue to implement these policies effectively and accelerate cultivating new momentum in service trade.

title: Ministry of Commerce: Unwaveringly Promote High-Level Opening-Up, Implement More Practical Measures to Stabilize Exports and Expand Imports
summary: The Ministry of Commerce held a regular press conference. A reporter asked, the foreign trade data for the first five months has been released, how does the Ministry view the overall performance and structural highlights of China's foreign trade? The spokesperson of the Ministry of Commerce, He Yadong, stated that facing the complex and severe international political and economic situation this year, China's foreign trade has withstood pressure and maintained a steady and improving favorable trend. In January-May, the total value of goods trade imports and exports reached 20.68 trillion yuan, an increase of 15.3% compared to the same period last year. Among them, imports grew by 20.5%, and exports increased by 11.8%. Overall, China's foreign trade showed many highlights.

title: Land Rover Range Rover Evoque L price plummets to over 170,000 yuan? Dealer: It's true
summary: Recently, it was reported that the price of Land Rover Range Rover Evoque L has dropped significantly, with some terminal market transaction prices falling to 179,800 yuan or even lower. Compared to the official guidance price of 429,800 yuan, the drop is nearly 60%. summary: The Foreign Ministry spokesperson Lin Jian hosted a regular press conference. What is China's response?

title: How to Choose a Niche for Entrepreneurship? The State Launches Four Entrepreneurial Models for Targeted Support
summary: Recently, the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security and three other departments issued a notice to implement the Entrepreneurial Model Leadership Action. Lou Quan Chao, a second-level inspector from the Employment Promotion Department of the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, stated: To strengthen categorized guidance and support for entrepreneurship, guide various entrepreneurial entities to identify market demand positions, and pursue distinctive development paths, the action innovatively proposed four models to promote entrepreneurship.

The London Metal Exchange (LME) reported a decrease of 575 tons in lead inventory, 2,825 tons in aluminum inventory, 30 tons in tin inventory, 100 tons in zinc inventory, 2,275 tons in copper inventory, and 558 tons in nickel inventory.

title: Zhu Hexin Meets with Brazil's Deputy Minister of Finance Mathias Alencastro
summary: On June 10, Zhu Hexin, vice governor of the People's Bank of China and director of the State Administration of Foreign Exchange, met with Mathias Alencastro, deputy minister of finance of Brazil. The two sides exchanged views on further leveraging the role of the China-Brazil Sustainable Development Expansion of Production Capacity Cooperation Fund, deepening bilateral financial opening-up cooperation, and enhancing dialogue in the field of sustainable investment. Li Hongyan, vice director of the State Administration of Foreign Exchange, accompanied the meeting.

title: Li Shuhu Steps Down as Chairman of Zeekr
summary: According to Tianyancha App, Zhejiang Zeekr Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. has undergone business changes recently. Li Shuhu has stepped down as chairman, and An Conghui has stepped down as legal representative, with Gan Jiaye appointed as the new legal representative. The company was established in July 2021, with a registered capital of 13 billion RMB. Its business scope includes data processing services, data processing and storage support services, internet data services, and big data services, and is wholly owned by Zeekr Technology Limited.

title: Chairman Chen Hua of Kweichow Moutai: Company Has No Stock Split Plan
summary: On the afternoon of June 11, the 2025 shareholders' meeting of Kweichow Moutai was held at the Moutai Conference Center, with thousands of shareholders, institutional investors, and analysts from across the country gathering in Moutai Town. Regarding the stock split issue, Chen Hua, chairman of Moutai Group, stated that shareholder opinions are currently not unified and show significant differences. After comprehensive analysis, the company has no immediate plan to implement a stock split.

title: Dalian Commodity Exchange Announces Trading Schedule for the 2026 Dragon Boat Festival
summary: The Dalian Commodity Exchange announced that trading will be suspended from June 19 (Friday) to June 21 (Sunday). Trading will resume on June 22 (Monday). There will be no night session trading on June 18 (Thursday) evening. On June 22 (Monday), the collective bidding period for all contracts will be from 08:55 to 09:00. The night session trading will resume on the same day.

summary: Focus on 'light scenarios'.

title: Kuo: TSMC's CoPoS to Start Mass Production in Second Half of 2028, NVIDIA's Latest AI Chip May Be First to Adopt
summary: TSMC's next-generation advanced packaging technology CoPoS production schedule and technical details are gradually becoming clear. Analyst Kuo Ming-chih noted that TSMC's CoPoS is expected to enter mass production in the second half of 2028, targeting improved yield economics for large-scale AI chip packaging, with applications focusing on packaging requirements exceeding 9.5 times the mask size. Kuo also highlighted that NVIDIA's latest AI chip Feynman is likely to be one of the first adopters of CoPoS. The analyst explained the three-layer glass core substrate architecture and debunked three major industry misinterpretations about 'glass replacing ABF'. TSMC may lock in its competitive advantage in the packaging field until 2032.
